prompts.text: Would you rather have a weekly date night or a monthly weekend away?
Would you rather know every language or play every instrument?
Would you rather always be 10 minutes early or 20 minutes late?
Would you rather live by the sea or in the mountains?
Would you rather relive our first date or skip ahead to our 10th anniversary?
Would you rather cook together every night or never cook again?
Would you rather have a pet dragon or a pet unicorn?
Would you rather lose your phone for a week or your voice for a day?
Would you rather plan every holiday or be surprised every time?
Would you rather share one dessert or each have your own?
